title: Notice Required for an Early Exit by Floor Plan — Lease Term Agreement Terms
content:
For an insufficient notice charge on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement, the notice an exit requires is set by the floor plan of the lease: a Three-Bedroom Residence or Penthouse Residence requires 75 days; a Studio Residence or One-Bedroom Residence requires 45 days; any other floor plan requires the term program's notice to vacate days.

The floor plan is the one leased on the Apartment Home Lease.

| Floor plan on the Apartment Home Lease | Notice an exit requires |
|---|---|
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 75 days |
| Penthouse Residence | 75 days |
| Studio Residence | 45 days |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 45 days |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | the term program's notice to vacate days |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | the term program's notice to vacate days |

The term program's notice to vacate days, for the last two rows:

| Term program | Notice to vacate days |
|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 30 |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 30 |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 45 |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 60 |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 60 |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 60 |

*Examples (hypothetical).* A Penthouse Residence lease on a Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) term requires 75 days; a Studio Residence lease on a Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) term requires 45 days; a Two-Bedroom Residence lease on a Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term requires 60 days.
